data.reason: This is a provisional full-text workflow checkpoint, not a protocol eligibility inclusion. On 2026-11-10, agent tool-mediated viewing directly rendered an institutional public PDF displaying the original ACM Transactions on Human-Robot Interaction 14(2), Article 29, 25 printed pages, DOI 10.1145/3706066 and CC BY 4.0 on article 29:1. Inspected displayed title/abstract and selected original sections 3.1–3.7 (article 29:4–29:9), 4.1 and selected results/discussion/limitations (29:9–29:14), with PDF visual pages 8–9 independently inspected. The main study describes natural versus mechanical spoken NICO robot advice in a between-subject Battleship task; §3.7 explicitly distinguishes the online voice pre-study from the in-person main-study recruitment and excludes pre-study participants from the main study. These are author-reported phases, NOT two admitted independent experiments/samples. Provisional E1–E6 for the main study appears promising; definitive full-text inclusion, source/reading-event evidence and study/experiment/sample ledger remain on hold while R004/Integration registers one lawfully retained exact-byte original manifestation and the reading can be pinned to it. No numerical extraction or voice playback performed.
